notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.content:
Hello everyone,


We are very happy to announce that Tales of Polygonia is leaving Early Access. We have made some improvements that you will definitely like.
[list]
[*] full support for mouse and keyboard (can be changed inside settings menu)
[*] detailed list of key bindings and controls
[*] Co-op mode and Remote Play have been revised and improved (more on this below)
[*] 19 Steam achievements are now available (more on this below)
[*] New Game+ has been added and is available once the game has been completed
[*] receive a special item when you start a New Game+
[*] added a special reward for completing the game on HARD
[*] missing indicators for interactable structures have been added
[*] AI-navigation has been revised
[*] character weight has been increased
[*] many minor bug fixes
[/list]
Co-op mode and remote play:
In order to use co-op mode, at least one controller must be connected in addition to the mouse and keyboard. If only one controller is available, the main player must play with a mouse and keyboard. To do so, select the controls in the settings.
If there are two controllers, the main player takes over the controller which is registered as the first controller in the system. The same applies to the second player with the second controller registered in the system.
If necessary, the controllers must be correctly assigned manually over the interface via Remote Play. A controller that is registered as a third, fourth, etc. controller will not be noticed by the game.

Steam Achievements:
Some achievements can be awarded backdated. To do this, select an existing save file and start the game. Unfortunately, this doesn't affect collection achievements or anything similar. These will be automatically restarted.

We will let you know as soon as there is news about further updates. Thank you and have a great time.
Chris

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.content:
Hello everyone,


The story comes to an deserved end with the new update "Tale of the mysterious Drake". Unfortunately, there were repeated delays in development, but now the time has finally come.
[list]
[*] four new maps
[*] two new bosses
[*] previous bosses revised and some new movesets added
[*] seven new enemies
[*] Damage from enemies increased
[*] over 20 new items (weapons, armor, misc)
[*] new weapon type (secret)
[*] enemies no longer respawn over time, but Souls-Like by saving at save spots (e.g. campfires)
[*] perfect combo attacks now give a stacking 50% bonus damage
[*] perfect blocks no longer consume stamina (more dynamic in combat)
[*] movement speed reduced
[*] stamina consumption for sprinting and swimming reduced
[*] player health increased
[*] calculations of status values ​​have been revised
[*] jump passages revised
[*] new puzzles and existing ones revised
[*] added indicators for usable objects (not for secret ones!)
[*] preparations for local co-op mode
[*] increased customization options in the character editor
[*] screenshake available and can be deactivated/activated via options
[*] added indicators for already discovered locations on the world map
[*] countless smaller bug fixes
[/list]
We are currently planning a local co-op mode and have already made some preparations. We will let you know as soon as there is news about further updates. Thank you and have a great time.
Chris

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

at the same time as the release of our demo, we made some changes that we want to present to you here.

[list]
[*] release of the demo
[*] tweeks for some enemy health and damage
[*] fixed minor bugs
[*] preparations for the final biome
[/list]

The savegame of the demo is of course fully compatible with the full version of the game, so you can simply continue playing from the last save point. The next steps will be the completion of the last biome that we will release next month and the overhaul of the character editor. We will keep you up to date.

Chris

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,


the story continues in the new update "Tale of the Guardian Spirit".
[i]"Get ready to battle the guardian spirit of the forest. Solve the riddle of his summoning and defeat him. Some rewards await you, so try your luck."[/i]
[list]
[*] World Boss "Forest Guardian Spirit"
[*] New Items (Necklace, Bow Enhancement, Summoning Items)
[*] Enemy "Dark Forest Deer" has been reworked
[*] Aggro Range has been increased by 25%-30%
[*] minor bug fixes
[/list]
Next we will revise the UI layout. We will let you know as soon as there is news about further updates. Thank you and have a great time.
Chris

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,


this weekend will be great. Version 0.5.4 is coming and will include lots of new content.
[list]

[*] new items (materials, bow)
[*] minor bug fixes (collision, movement)
[/list]

We will publish a more detailed list with the release. Thank you and have a great time.
Chris

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,


unfortunately we had to delay the start of Early Access by about 4 weeks. The release was planned for Christmas. Unfortunately this collides with other events, so we had to shift to January 21, 2023. But we will use this time productively.

The character editor will be revised and expanded:
[list]
[*] male and female body types
[*] more colors
[/list]

New items:
[list]
[*] new armor set
[*] new tool
[/list]

New enemies:
[list]
[*] new boss
[/list]


If there will be any additional content, you will find out here first. Thank you and have a great time.
Chris
